items.title: Rachaad White: Won't play in Saturday's preseason game
items.description:
White (hamstring) won't play in Saturday's preseason game against the Lions, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Tyler Warren: Groin injury not believed to be serious
items.description:
Warren (groin) suffered a strained abductor in Wednesday's practice but is expected to return to practice next week, NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports.

items.title: Vita Vea: Agrees to one-year extension with Bucs
items.description:
Vea (back) and the Buccaneers reached an agreement on a one-year, $30 million extension Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Bo Nix: In line to play in Friday's preseason contest
items.description:
Coach Sean Payton said Nix is expected to play roughly 14 snaps during Friday's preseason game against the Packers, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
